text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Takarazuka Kinen still<n>looking unlikely, a
dismal mood has<n>fallen over the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Big Brother. I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Big Sister. I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
So she says, but her smile looks<n>empty. It must still
be bothering her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Buzz... buzz...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I have to go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I have to go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Not far!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Where in the world could Rice Shower<n>be going?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Was that Rice Shower that just ran<n>by?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I-I think so. She looked really intense.<n>You don't
think—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: S-stop! She's always working so<n>hard, so don't...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I race up the stairs. Please tell me this<n>pit in the
bottom of my stomach is<n>totally unfounded!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Please... ask them to let us use the<n>course!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I tear across the corridor toward her<n>voice.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Patience! There are certain<n>procedures that must be
followed<n>before I—

But I've already asked the Hanshin<n>staff! And the
Kyoto staff too!
So please... save the Takarazuka<n>Kinen!
Astonishment! Now Trainer <username> is here<n>too?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I came to ask the director for<n>something.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking we could hold the<n>Takarazuka Kinen
at the Kyoto<n>Racecourse.

Indeed! She asked just last night as<n>well, if
memory serves.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Alas! It is not my decision to make.<n>We must first
contact—

B-but I told you—I've already<n>contacted the Hanshin
and Kyoto<n>Racecourses!

Sorry to cause you trouble, and I<n>know it's not
easy, but please help<n>us!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, please! I want to do<n>everything I
possibly can for all the<n>people who have supported
me up<n>until now!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-now, now... Let's all calm<n>dow—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: S-sorry for the delay! I have good<n>news!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Tazuna! My savior!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This year's Takarazuka Kinen will be<n>held at the
Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Both the Hanshin and Kyoto<n>Racecourses'
staff have been talking<n>to each other behind the
scenes.<n>They're determined to make it<n>happen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They're giving it their all for this<n>race... and for you,
Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hic... I'm so glad... that they'reholding the race.
choice_data_list: Now it's your turn to work hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah! Not just for me, but for<n>everyone
who's working hard to<n>make this happen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And for everyone who's supported<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in the Takarazuka<n>Kinen... and
make everyone smile!
